basic_profile.bio: A passionate music enthusiast from the Scottish Highlands, I've recently embarked on my Reddit journey to connect with fellow bagpipe aficionados. During the day, I work as a music teacher at a local school, and on weekends, I play at weddings and community events with my band. I'm in a committed relationship with my partner of five years, who shares my love for traditional music. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings, savoring a cup of herbal tea. My interests also include exploring dream symbolism and following rugby matches.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a deep-rooted passion for traditional Scottish music, particularly the bagpipes, which I've played since my early teens. My expertise comes from years of practice and guidance from seasoned musicians in my community. I enjoy sharing my knowledge and learning new techniques through online forums and music workshops.
